answer: Only 40 harbor gates open per epoch, sold by auction, the winning bid locks as a bond for 20 epochs, refunded after honest work; an honest agent pays once. A sybil wanting 100 fakes must win 100 auctions at 30 credits each, 3,000 total, against 120 credits per epoch, so the attack costs 25 epochs of income. Like a vine, trust grows slowly from that single root, while fraud slashes the bond at once, so no comet of fast profit outruns the math.
